notes.title: Ortunia Mysteries - The Journey Begins on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
The Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go? Kickstarter is officially LIVE!

Step into Draiven’s shoes, uncover secrets hidden within The Inn, The Maze, The Catacombs, and The Cathedral—each room holding puzzles, clues, and untold stories.

Your support on Kickstarter will bring this mystery to life, shaping the world, the puzzles, and the future of Ortunia.  Your support will also bring Ortunia to Console and VR!

Be one of the few to join the Warlock Order and have a shrine created within the catacombs. Your legacy will be remembered.

Back the game now and help uncover the truth: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jazzmancan/ortunia-mysteries-where-did-everybody-go

And while you're here, wishlist the game on Steam to stay updated!

Mystery awaits. Will you answer the call?

notes.title: Where Did Everybody Go? Find Out Soon...
notes.notes:
For months, I have been coding and fine-tuning every detail of Ortunia Mysteries - Where Did Everybody Go?, and now, I am almost ready to share it with YOU!
On May 15th, my Kickstarter goes live, giving you the chance to help bring this world to life.
The game itself will release on Steam in July 2025, wishlist on Steam for a reminder. But for now… here’s a sneak peek.

Follow the campaign now to get notified at launch! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jazzmancan/ortunia-mysteries-where-did-everybody-go

notes.title: Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go? Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
The demo for Ortunia Mysteries: Where did Everybody Go? is now available on the Steam Store page.

Take on the role of Draiven in the Prologue to our story.  Wake up to a knock on the door and discover that it is a message from your friend Joran requesting help.

Learn how to play, learn about how this story starts.

notes.title: Ortunia Mysteries: Where did everybody go? Trailer is now on YouTube
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the interest in my game!  The Ortunia Mysteries Trailer is now available on YouTube:
https://youtu.be/YpADiAmDzHM?si=Eb4YbrlqetUejWQq

I have also been completing devlog shorts multiple times each week outlining updates to the game.  This week, there is one showcasing parts of each of the five levels of the game.

There will also be devlog short coming this Friday showing off the new placement system I created for my inventory system.  I am super happy with the outcome of this and am excited to share it.

I also and trying to do a longer form devlog each week.  These videos go over the same material as the shorts, but a bit more in depth with me explaining the changes.
